stories.title: Red Sox-Cubs finale, moved due to Boston weather, set for Sun. at Tropicana
stories.summary: The Red Sox and Cubs will play their regular-season finale Sunday afternoon at Tropicana Field after the league relocated their series from Boston because of the forecast for inclement weather.

stories.title: Kyrie ready to 'kick some butt' after lengthy ACL recovery
stories.summary: Kyrie Irving said he is under no physical restrictions from the torn ACL in his left knee that sidelined him 19 months ago, an injury that he called "probably the best thing that happened to me."

stories.title: QB Darnold back Sunday, but Seahawks down two safeties
stories.summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will start Sunday, but the defending Super Bowl champions will be without both starting safeties as Julian Love and Ty Okada have been ruled out.

stories.title: NFL, NFLPA continue to monitor field conditions in Rio
stories.summary: Field experts for the NFL and the NFL Players Association have been in Brazil for days to monitor the playing surface at Maracanã Stadium, NFLPA executive director JC Tretter said in a lengthy statement on Friday.

stories.title: Jays star Guerrero backtracks, expresses 'regret' over contract remarks
stories.summary: Blue Jays star Vladimir Guerrero, who earlier this week said he stood by his remarks that he received a $500 million extension for what he did in the past, said he owed an apology for comments that were "not what I really wanted to say."
